question: Best Florida school for future doctors?
vote_note: Send this to a parent of a future doctor. 🩺

a.label: UF
a.name: University of Florida
bullets: UF College of Medicine + UF Health Shands, the flagship hospital, in Gainesville
Pre-health advising for students from their first semester
Its old BS/MD (Medical Honors Program) no longer takes applications

b.label: USF
b.name: University of South Florida
bullets: 3 years in the Judy Genshaft Honors College + 4 at the Morsani College of Medicine
For students starting right after high school: 4.0 weighted GPA + 1500 SAT or 34 ACT, biomedical sciences major

second.title: Want to be a doctor? This one's for you. 🩺
second.lead: Both have a medical school and a big health system. Only one has a 7-year path you can qualify for straight out of high school.
